Coordinator.Wire: Fixed numeric profiles only; no command/path/argv launch authority

RawArchive.Scope: Actual benchmark reports/logs, prepared fixtures, immutable identities, executed helpers, coordinator journals and ownership cleanup; also retains earlier failed source/ASan evidence

Retirement.Scope: Every executed outer and nested Job checked reaped; process census found no task-root command line; no owned PID remains to retain a listener

Limitations: Headless synthetic mixed workloads; no graphical, physical input, or general 64-player qualification.
At 16/32 peers with 512 objects, baseline warmups fail; candidate-only large-world results are not paired speedups.
32-peer final structural convergence takes 6.58–6.96 seconds after the coordinated close, inside the existing 10-second failure policy; tracked separately as GL-039.

Release static-memory byte monitor returns zero and is unavailable, not evidence of zero memory growth. Object/node counts and machine commit headroom are observed; no allocation-rate or total-process-RSS claim.
Whole-process CPU includes startup/warmup/teardown; native occupancy is sampled, not an exact high-water guarantee.
Large ASan peer matrices remain resource-preflight limited. Long-duration reconnect storms and broader impaired-link profiles remain separate campaign coverage.
